thread:
Maya: Heads-up — draft onboarding "Ramp Playbook" proposal for new model catalog entries. Two paths: 'ramp' and 'safe' (fast ramp for low-risk open models, safe for enterprise/pinned ones). Need alignment on acceptance gates, benchmarks, and canary cohort rules. Ping @Ari @Sam for impacts.
Ari: skimmed. Quick Q: what are the metric pass thresholds? latency and output-quality? Also KV-cache / prefix caching behavior could change perf — want presample tests.
Maya: Good call. Proposal: latency p50/p95 targets (p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms) for hosted baseline; quality measured via eval set A/B with relative delta < 1.5% regression on top-3 metrics (F1 / ROUGE for summarization). If either fails, route to Safe track. 
Diego: do we have a strict cost ceiling for ramp? customers ask about unit cost. propose cost-per-1k-tokens delta <= 12% vs reference.
Sam: For enterprise contracts, customers want an opt-in canary (only their traffic). Can we support per-customer pinning during canary? Some will insist.
Ari: yes per-customer routing exists but we need to ensure model-variant compatibility. Also suggest a KV-cache smoke test: run prefix-heavy 1000-req batch and measure cache hit ratio + tail latency.
Maya: adding that. Sketch of required artifacts before canary:
- preflight benchmarks (latency, cache-hit sim, cost estimate)
- eval diffs on standard prompt corpus
- compatibility matrix (tokenizer, special tokens, logits-delta)
- rollout policy (percent steps, rollback gates)
Diego: rollback gates — define strict criteria. my suggestion: if QoQ deg > 2% or p95 increases > 40% absolute, immediate rollback.
Ari: also include KV-cache warmup window and expected warmup SLO. Tests should include cold and warm runs.
Maya: agree. Also propose "customer cohort labels" for canary: internal-beta, partner-ppm, enterprise-contract. Each label maps to default percent steps.
Sam: for enterprise opt-ins, need docs + customer consent form. I'll prepare templates.
Ari: small nit — we should measure hallucination regressions for QA tasks; add a hallucination rate metric using our eval harness.
Maya: yep. Update: acceptance gate table draft:
```
metric | pass condition
latency p95 | <= 220ms or <= baseline*1.2
eval quality delta | <= +1.5% regression
cost per 1k tokens | <= baseline*1.12
kv-cache hit ratio | >= baseline - 5%
hallucination rate | <= baseline + 1%
```
Sam: sounds good. timeline? we'd need ~2 weeks for preflight + 1 week for partner canaries.
Maya: propose: week1 preflight, week2 partner canaries (0.5%-5%), week3 partner expansion + enterprise canaries. ops-bot: Deploy checklists created: https://redwood.internal/ops/onboard-playbook (auto)
Diego: can we add a mid-rollback smoke test after 5% bump? Just to catch regressions that show up at scale.
Ari: agree. Add health-checks per-step: error-rate, token-drop, p95.
Maya: Cool. Action items:
- Ari: finalize KV-cache smoke test harness by Wed
- Diego: define rollback thresholds and automation tickets
- Sam: customer consent + docs template
- Maya: finalize playbook and send to PM+SRE for review
Maya: anything else? :eyes:
Sam: one ask — include an explicit customer migration path if customers are pinned and deprecate later.
Maya: added to TODOs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
